A rewrite of Miguelaka95's BetterCC.

Resizes Control Center modules and fills the grid with invisible spacers.

* resize the media player for portrait & landscape.
* show album artwork behind the media player.
* widen Video Effects & Mic Mode.
* add up to 12 invisible modules.

Rootless build, not yet tested.

* show the package icon after install.
* add a Tip on Ko-fi row to the credits.
* name the original first in the description.
* credit Miguelaka95's BetterCC in the description.
